chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, who said:
I came to Khurāsān while I was a Wāqifī. I carried goods with me, and there was with me a patterned cloth in one of the bundles, but I was unaware of it and did not know its location.

So when I arrived in Marw and lodged in one of its dwellings, suddenly there was a Madinan man from among its muwallads, and he said to me: Abu al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام says to you: Send to me the patterned cloth that is with you. He said: So I said, Who informed Abu al-Ḥasan of my arrival, when I have only just arrived, and I do not have any patterned cloth with me?

So he returned to him and came back to me, and said: He says to you: Yes, it is in such-and-such a place, and its bundle is such-and-such. So I searched for it where he said, and I found it at the bottom of the bundle, and I sent it to him.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the Imam referred to in the report
key_terms.الرِّزَمِ: bundles or packed loads among the traveler’s goods
key_terms.خُرَاسَانَ: Khurāsān, the region to which the narrator traveled
key_terms.مَرْوَ: Marw, the city where the event took place
key_terms.مُوَلَّدِيهَا: those affiliated with or born among the people of that place
key_terms.وَاقِفٌ: a follower of the Wāqifī sect

ai.seo_question: How does this narration demonstrate the divinely granted knowledge of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report narrates an incident in which Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام informed a man of a hidden cloth among his belongings, despite the man himself being unaware of its location. The narration serves as a sign affirming the Imam’s divinely granted knowledge and supports the truth of the Imamate.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa who said,
‘I went to Khurasan and I was a Waqifiite. So I carried provisions and there were clothes for me and something in one of the packets, and I was not aware of it and did not know of its place.

So when I proceeded to Merv and lodged in one of its lodgings and did not publicise except that a Medinite man from one of its tribes came over and said to me, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws is saying to you: ‘Send over to measws the Washy cloth which is with you’. So I said, ‘And who informed Abu Al-Hassanasws of my coming over here and I have just come, and there is not Washy cloth with me’.

So he returned to him<sup>asws</sup> and came back to me and said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> is saying to you: ‘Yes (you do), and it is in such and such a place, and in such and such a packet’. So I looked for it where he<sup>asws</sup> said it to be, and I found it in the lowest of the packets. So I sent it over to him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 12. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from (al-Hassan ibn Ali) al-Washsha’ who has said the following.

“I came to Khurasan when I was a member of the Waqifa sect. I had certain goods with me. In these goods there was a printed piece of fabric in one of the bundles. It was misplaced and did not know where it was.

When I arrived in Marv and found a lodging a man who was born in the city of Madina came by and said to me, “Abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.) said to you, “send to me the piece of printed fabric that is with you.” He has said that I then said, “Who has told abu al-Hassan (a.s.) about my arrival here? I have just arrived. There is no printed fabric with me.”

He went back to the Imam (a.s.) and returned to me saying, “The Imam (a.s.) says, “It is in such and such place and in such and such bundle.” I then looked for it as he had said and found it at the bottom of the bundle and then I sent it to him.”
